description: This is a server-side code-behind file for the StartExam.aspx page in an online examination system. It manages user session validation, dynamic course selection based on the student's semester, initiation of theory or MCQ exams, and navigation to exam pages while checking if the student has already taken the exam.

classes.name: StartExam
classes.description: A code-behind class for managing start exam page events and logic in an ASP.NET WebForms application.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; checks session, dynamically populates course list based on semester.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the user profile page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Currently empty; placeholder for select button logic.

methods.name: startB_Click
methods.description: Starts the selected exam after validating exam type and course availability, sets session variables accordingly.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Empty handler for semester dropdown change.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Empty handler for course dropdown change.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of theory exams, checks if already taken, sets start question number, and navigates to exam page.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of MCQ exams, checks if already taken, sets start question number, and navigates to exam page.
